scope: 10 deterministic real test image patches; all 64 Conv1 filters; not full-network accuracy

dataset.selection: first official-test-order image for each configured fine label; no selection by response
dataset.load_method: pickletools opcode inspection; no pickle callbacks executed

input_preprocessing: uint8 CHW /255 float32; no normalization, crop augmentation or flip; deterministic patch top-left13,13
flatten_order: C,H,W; 75 coefficients; same Conv1 weight order
spike_time_formula: floor((1-x)*11), clipped[0,11]; x<.1 silent; one spike maximum
limitations: This is deterministic CPU float32 reference, not a bitwise promise for other BLAS/GPU convolution order.
No hardware performed; no four-filter mapping or classification accuracy established.
Training validation indices in split_manifest are not test image indices.
BNTT executes all12 steps including t10/11 with no input spikes.
